name: MISC Berhad
overview: 2026年，MISC Berhad 联合其他联合要约方提出全面收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 的股权，涉及 Offshore Business 板块的扩张；同时，一家间接全资子公司 AET Azerbaijan Ltd 启动成员自愿清盘，该公司自注册以来未开展运营。此外，公司续租 Menara Dayabumi 办公空间作为总部。
overview_en: In 2026, MISC Berhad, together with other joint offerors, proposed a conditional voluntary general offer to acquire the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad not already owned by the excluded shareholders, involving expansion of the Offshore Business segment. Meanwhile, AET Azerbaijan Ltd, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, commenced members' voluntary winding up; it had not commenced operations since incorporation.

segments.name: 离岸业务
segments.note: 今年联合其他要约方提出全面收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 股权，以扩大离岸业务。
segments.note_en: This year, together with other joint offerors, proposed a full acquisition of equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad to expand the offshore business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 联合要约方就收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 的提议向 YHB 发出新闻通知。
actions.text_en: The joint offerors issued a press notice to YHB regarding the proposed acquisition of Yinson Holdings Berhad.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: MISC 联合其他联合要约方及联合最终要约方。
actions.text_en: MISC, together with other joint offerors and joint ultimate offerors, proposed to acquire the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad not already owned by the excluded shareholders by way of a members' scheme of arrangement.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成一间未运营间接全资子公司的成员自愿清盘，并续租总部办公空间。
segments.note_en: This year, completed the members' voluntary winding up of an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary that had not commenced operations, and renewed the head office tenancy.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 间接全资子公司 AET Azerbaijan Ltd 根据阿塞拜疆法律启动成员自愿清盘，该公司自注册以来未开展运营。
actions.text_en: AET Azerbaijan Ltd, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, commenced members' voluntary winding up under the laws of the Republic of Azerbaijan; it had not commenced operations since incorporation.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 PETRONAS 签订长期租约，续租 Menara Dayabumi 办公空间，为期3年并自动续约4个连续3年期。
actions.text_en: Entered into a long-term tenancy agreement with PETRONAS to renew the rental of office space at Menara Dayabumi for a 3-year term with automatic renewal of four consecutive terms of three years each.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过联合要约方式拟收购 Yinson Holdings Berhad 全部股权，可能使 Offshore Business 板块业务规模扩大。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed acquisition of the entire equity interest in Yinson Holdings Berhad through a joint offer, which may expand the scale of the Offshore Business segment.
